info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Operational Services Card Collection By Card Collection Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API enables authorized users to update details of a specific card collection within the banking operational services. By providing the card collection ID, consumers can modify attributes such as status, metadata, or associated user data. Typical users include banking administrators and service operators who need to maintain accurate records in the card management system. This operation helps ensure that information remains current and relevant, thus supporting efficient banking operations.

patch.summary: Update card collection details for a specific card.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of the specified card collection identified by its unique ID. Make sure to provide the necessary fields in the request body to reflect the updates you wish to make.

requestBody.description: Request body for updating the details of the card collection identified by CARD-400045. This payload includes the updated attributes that need to be modified within the card collection's record.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
